newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI AGRICULTURE BANK TO GET NEW CREDIT LINE.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI AGRICULTURE BANK TO GET NEW CREDIT LINE.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) said on Thursday the state Agriculture Development Bank (ADB) would get a one-time credit-line worth 6.4 billion rupees ($158.1 million) to finance production loans.
It said in a statement domestic banks would give ADB the credit-line, to be guaranteed by the government at a mark-up (interest) of 13 percent per annum, repayable within a year of its disbursement.
The ADB will charge farmers 14 percent or less against the loans, the SBP said.
The decision will provide bank credit for agriculture and meet production targets, it said.
The 6.4-billion rupee credit line will be in addition to existing lending operations of banks for agriculture. ($ = 40.47 Pakistani Rupees)
